SELECT id,i+CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS summed,i-CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS difference,
       i*CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS product,i/CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS quotient
FROM bench WHERE id < 8

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id,i AS dividend,p AS divisor FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, dividend / CAST(divisor AS BIGINT) AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 'bad' ELSE '2' END AS raw, p
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, CAST(raw AS INT) / CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE WHEN id=1 THEN 'bad' ELSE '2' END AS raw, p
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, CAST(raw AS INT) / CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id,CAST(CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 'bad' ELSE '2' END AS BIGINT) AS dividend,p
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, dividend / CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS result FROM operands
SELECT id, i / CAST(CASE WHEN id=1 THEN 0 ELSE p END AS BIGINT) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id, CAST(ROUND(CAST(dec AS DECIMAL(18,2))/CAST(p AS DECIMAL(18,2)),2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id,i+CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS summed, i/CAST(p AS BIGINT) AS quotient FROM bench WHERE id<0
SELECT id, CAST(dec AS DECIMAL(18,2))/CAST(p AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id, CAST(dec AS DECIMAL(18,2))/CAST(p AS DECIMAL(11,2)) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id, CAST(dec AS DECIMAL(18,3))/CAST(p AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
